aboutHome.aboutProText: I develop web applications focused on performance, accessibility, and modern design. I'm committed to best practices, maintainable architectures, and a detail-oriented mindset. My goal is to create software that delivers real value to both businesses and users.
aboutHome.aboutPersonalTitle: A mix of creativity and curiosity
aboutHome.aboutPersonalText: Besides development, I enjoy exploring art, training, traveling, and learning new things. I love experimenting, building personal projects, and challenging myself. I believe that creativity outside of code fuels creativity within it.

aboutme.title: About me
aboutme.subtitle: Who I am, what I do, and what drives me.
aboutme.introP1: I'm not one to stay in theory. I like to understand how things work, get hands-on, and improve along the way.
aboutme.introP2: I spend most of my time building projects, learning new tools, and finding ways to make things simpler and more efficient.
aboutme.introP3: I don't overthink it: I prefer to do, make mistakes, and improve.
aboutme.gamingText: I'm drawn to games where progress depends on practice, consistency, and learning from mistakes. I enjoy environments where getting better is part of the process.
aboutme.gymP1: Training is a key part of my routine. It taught me discipline, consistency, and to push through even when I don't feel like it.
aboutme.gymP2: I apply that mindset directly to how I work and tackle problems.
aboutme.musicP1: Music is part of my daily life. It's with me when I train, when I'm focused on work, or when I want to disconnect.
aboutme.musicP2: I'm interested in how it influences my energy, focus, and mental state.
